title: Ὑπόμνημα εἰς τὴν Πτολεμαίου μαθηματικὴν σύνταξιν — Commentary on Ptolemy's Almagest; RU: Теон Александрийский, «Комментарий к „Альмагесту“»
author: Theon of Alexandria
size: Multi-book commentary; Rome's edition covers I–IV, the rest only Basel 1538; est. 150k+ words in total
edition: Rome, Studi e Testi 72 and 106 (1936–43; copyright). Basel 1538 editio princeps and Halma 1821–22 (I–II with French), public domain.
ru_evidence: Not in the ΣΧΟΛΗ translation index or ru.wikipedia; no Russian version found.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia «Theon of Alexandria» lists only Rome's and Tihon's French-language editions; no English translation found.
other_translations: French: Halma 1821–22 (Books I–II). Tihon's French translations cover Theon's Handy Tables commentaries, not the Almagest.
value: The principal late-antique guide to Ptolemy: sexagesimal arithmetic in Book I; the Book III heading credits Hypatia's edition, central to Hypatia and Alexandrian scholarship. Basis of Byzantine and Arabic Almagest teaching.
ai_feasibility: medium: formulaic mathematical prose; code agents must recompute every calculation; Halma serves for cross-checking.
pilot_unit: Book I, est. 15–20k words (incl. sexagesimal division)
